speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for National Development whether a percentage of the HDB community care apartments to be launched for seniors can be allotted for suitable younger persons with disabilities so that they can live within the community.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: We can look forward to the task force's recommendations next year.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: There are also various SSAs that have initiatives to enable persons with disabilities to live independently in the community and we will support these where we can.
